label: Mean male height by birth cohort
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = the NCD Risk Factor Collaboration's 2016 eLife compilation (1,472 population-based measurement studies re-analyzed; mean height at age 18 by birth cohort, 200 entities, 1896-1996) via OWID's chart door, single-column clean. Witness tier = Baten & Blum (2015) via Clio-Infra (the historical anthropometric record, 153 entities, 1550-2000) — a genuinely cross-root compilation agreeing at the cm level on the overlapping cohorts. Authenticity first per ADR-0008: two independent compilations displayed beside each other, never blended.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): OWID chart doors = CC-BY-4.0 (OWID's chart-door terms; content: NCD Risk Factor Collaboration (2016), and Baten & Blum (2015) via Clio-Infra — the compilations' own reuse terms apply upstream).
notes: THE TODD ARC PRINTS ITSELF (todd_refs: 1 citation, Après la démocratie): the book's +10cm French century prints BIGGER — FRANCE birth-1896 = 166.41 -> birth-1996 = 179.74 (+13.3cm, 101 annual cohort points), the Third-Republic's own scoreboard curve; read on Todd's calendar framing the 1900-to-2005 window maps to the birth-1880-to-1985 cohorts, the seam documented in sources. The catch-up arcs the living-standard literature leans on print alongside: SOUTH KOREA 159.75 -> 174.95 (+15.2cm, the biggest gain in the compilation), JAPAN 156.17 -> 170.82 (+14.7), NETHERLANDS 169.43 -> 182.54 (the tallest, the postwar protein curve), UNITED STATES 171.08 -> 177.13, RUSSIA 166.97 -> 176.46. THE WITNESS'S OWN REACH: the pre-1896 tail (FRA 1660 = 162.6, RUS 1700 = 163.9) carries the early-modern record the canonical cannot — the barro_lee relation, the historical face on the witness tier. THE HONEST LIMITS: the framing seams (birth-cohort vs calendar year; age 18 vs Todd's age 20 — both documented, never reconciled); the 1996+ cohorts live behind the 2020 child/adolescent study (a different publication, registered as the future door); the Women column (the same door's second column) is the registered future door for a female face no corpus metric yet demands; the pre-1550 and the regional (French départemental) faces are BOOK/curated territory; the Baten-Blum witness is sparse by nature (27 French points across 340 years — the compilation's own density, displayed as what it is).
